tools.name: verify_work
tools.description: Checks delivered work against agreed terms and returns an Ed25519-signed pass/fail outcome receipt with per-check evidence (ERC-8004 compatible). job_type 'dataset_spec/v1': artifact is an array of rows; spec may set row_schema (JSON Schema), min_rows, max_rows, unique_key, freshness {field, max_age

tools.name: check_receipt
tools.description: Fetches a Verified Work receipt by id (or takes the receipt JSON) and verifies its Ed25519 signature against the verifier's published key. Free.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Returns the verifier's current x402 payment terms (amount, asset, network, recipient) without paying. Free.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_work" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_work · Private data: verify_work · Public sink: verify_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_work · Private data: verify_work · Public sink: verify_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
